jobgether-jobgether:lever:31e6f6b0-4f23-.title: Head of Data Center Design
jobgether-jobgether:lever:31e6f6b0-4f23-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Data Center Design based in Germany. As Head of Data Center Design, you will take ownership of the technical vision and architecture for a major next-generation AI data center development in Europe. You’ll lead design decisions across power, cooling, IT infrastructure, fire protection, networking, and structural considerations. The role offers significant technical influence, from early site feasibility and concept development through detailed engineering and construction execution. You’ll establish the Basis of Design and ensure that multidisciplinary teams remain aligned with performance, capacity, efficiency, and reliability objectives. Working with technology partners and implementation teams, you’ll ensure approved designs translate effectively into real-world infrastructure. The environment is international, technically complex, and focused on large-scale, high-density compute infrastructure. This is an opportunity to shape a critical infrastructure project designed to support the rapidly growing demands of AI and advanced computing. Own the overall technical design, architecture, and engineering vision for large-scale data center facilities. Define and maintain the Basis of Design , covering modular POD architecture, cooling strategy, power topology, fire suppression, networking, and other critical infrastructure requirements. Establish design standards for IT deployment, including rack layouts, containerization approaches, and CDU placement. Lead multidisciplinary design reviews and approve engineering drawings across electrical, mechanical, structural, fire protection, and networking disciplines. Establish and monitor design-stage targets for PUE, capacity, availability, redundancy, and reliability . Coordinate with equipment manufacturers, technology providers, and engineering partners on technical specifications and integration requirements. Work closely with implementation and construction teams to ensure that physical execution remains aligned with the approved design intent. Assess and approve proposed design changes, evaluating their potential impact on cooling, power, capacity, redundancy, performance, and reliability. Lead technical criteria for site selection and feasibility assessments, including power availability, grid connectivity, cooling options, and other infrastructure considerations. Provide technical leadership throughout the design lifecycle and ensure consistent engineering standards across projects and disciplines. Requirements 5+ years of experience in data center design or in the design of critical infrastructure, industrial, energy, or similarly complex facilities ; direct data center experience is highly valued but not mandatory. Demonstrated ownership of, or significant contribution to, Basis of Design documentation for large-scale facilities. At least 3 years of experience in a design leadership or technical leadership position. Strong technical knowledge of power distribution/topology and cooling strategies , with sufficient working knowledge of fire suppression and structural loading to coordinate effectively across disciplines. Proven experience leading multidisciplinary design reviews and reviewing or approving engineering drawings across multiple technical trades. Strong ability to translate technical requirements into clear design standards, decisions, and execution requirements. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with engineering teams, technology partners, suppliers, and construction teams. Professional English proficiency sufficient for international technical documentation, meetings, and stakeholder communication. Experience with modular or POD-based deployment architectures and high-density GPU/HPC environments is a strong advantage. Knowledge of direct liquid cooling (DLC) systems is bene

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ea6eb61f-9a08-.title: Sr 3D Art Generalist - Brookhaven
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ea6eb61f-9a08-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr 3D Art Generalist - Brookhaven based in United States. This is a senior 3D art role focused on creating and delivering high-quality assets for a large-scale, continuously evolving Roblox experience. You’ll help shape environments, houses, props, tools, gameplay content, and other visual assets while maintaining a distinctive and consistent art direction. The role combines hands-on asset creation with technical art expertise, quality ownership, and collaboration across art, design, and game development teams. You’ll review other artists’ work, provide actionable feedback, and help guide execution against visual, technical, and performance standards. Because the game operates at significant scale, you’ll balance creative ambition with optimization, integration requirements, and real-time performance constraints. The ideal candidate is both an accomplished 3D artist and a thoughtful technical problem-solver who can elevate content without compromising the established visual identity. This is a fully remote opportunity suited to an experienced artist who enjoys autonomy, collaboration, and creating content experienced by millions of players. Review the work of other artists within assigned areas and provide clear, actionable feedback to drive iterations toward the required quality standard. Own the end-to-end production of assigned 3D assets, including houses, props, tools, environments, gameplay content, and SFX/VFX when required. Take assets from initial brief and concept through modeling, texturing, optimization, integration, polish, and final delivery. Partner closely with the Art Lead to align on artistic direction, conduct reviews, identify ambiguity, and proactively surface production risks. Coordinate and manage execution across designated content areas, ensuring visual consistency, technical quality, performance-budget compliance, and timely delivery. Evaluate asset requests and design documentation before production, identifying pipeline, implementation, or technical considerations that could affect delivery. Collaborate with designers, engineers, artists, and other game-team members to resolve visual bugs, integration challenges, and polish requirements. Ensure assigned content remains production-ready and shippable throughout development. Apply strong creative judgment to improve asset requests and introduce thoughtful artistic enhancements while remaining aligned with established direction. Contribute technical art expertise to help maintain efficient, scalable, and performance-conscious production workflows. Support the development of other artists through constructive feedback, collaboration, and knowledge sharing. Requirements Strong professional expertise creating performant 3D assets within Roblox Studio, with a thorough understanding of real-time optimization practices. Professional experience in a creative production environment, or equivalent experience gained through freelance work or independently developed projects. Deep understanding and appreciation of the established Brookhaven visual style, with the ability to reproduce and extend it consistently. Advanced 3D modeling capabilities, including clean topology, UV unwrapping, baking, and optimization for real-time gameplay. Strong knowledge of texturing workflows and material creation appropriate for Roblox and real-time environments. Demonstrated ability to bridge artistic and technical considerations, ensuring assets satisfy both visual expectations and gameplay requirements. Portfolio demonstrating high-quality Roblox environmental work, such as houses, map locations, event spaces, or collaboration areas. Portfolio showcasing strong technical-art thinking and performance-aware asset creation. Strong artistic instincts and attention to detail, with the ability to enhance assets while respecting established creative direction

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ec178741-69fe-.title: Senior Front-End UI/UX Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ec178741-69fe-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Front-End UI/UX Engineer based in South Africa. This role is an opportunity to shape intuitive, accessible, and high-quality digital experiences for complex enterprise applications. You will combine strong front-end engineering expertise with a deep understanding of UI/UX and accessibility principles. Working primarily within an ASP.NET MVC 5 environment, you will translate business and user needs into polished, maintainable interfaces. Your work will help ensure applications are usable, inclusive, responsive, and compliant with modern accessibility standards. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, customers, designers, QA specialists, and technology teams. The position offers a hands-on engineering environment where you can influence both technical implementation and the overall user experience. You will also contribute to technical specifications, testing, documentation, and the delivery of reliable production-ready solutions. Design, develop, enhance, and maintain accessible, user-centered interfaces for complex enterprise applications built on ASP.NET MVC 5. Translate business requirements, user needs, and design concepts into clean, intuitive, maintainable, and production-ready front-end experiences. Apply UI/UX principles including information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and responsive design to real-world applications. Implement and validate web accessibility in accordance with WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 requirements. Apply semantic HTML, ARIA roles and attributes, keyboard navigation, focus management, and other accessibility best practices. Test interfaces using assistive technologies and screen readers such as JAWS, NVDA, and VoiceOver, as appropriate. Develop and support full-stack .NET applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC 5, SQL Server, and related Microsoft technologies in a Windows environment. Build and integrate front-end experiences with RESTful APIs and internal or external systems. Work with Microsoft SQL Server, including data models, T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and views required to support application functionality. Prepare technical design specifications, technical documentation, and clear design documentation. Write and maintain unit tests while supporting QA, usability testing, accessibility validation, and release activities. Analyze requirements, troubleshoot complex UI and cross-browser issues, and deliver stable, polished solutions within established timelines. Collaborate with business stakeholders, customers, designers, and cross-functional technology teams to validate solutions and resolve issues. Contribute to design reviews, accessibility audits, usability initiatives, and continuous improvements to the application's user experience. Work independently within established enterprise codebases while identifying opportunities to modernize and improve legacy front-end components. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Design, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5–8+ years of professional software development experience, with significant hands-on experience in front-end and UI development. Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery, with a focus on clean, semantic, maintainable markup. Demonstrated ability to apply UI/UX principles such as information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and user-centered design. Hands-on experience implementing and testing accessible web experiences against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards. Practical knowledge of ARIA, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, focus management, and accessibility testing with assistive technologies. Strong proficiency in C# and ASP.NET MVC 5, with experience developing and supporting full-stack .NET applications in Windo

southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.title: Your Dream Job
southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.description: At Boom, we’re always looking for bold thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers—people who bring something extraordinary, even if we haven’t posted the perfect role yet. If you’re passionate about aviation, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and believe you can help accelerate our mission, we want to hear from you. Let’s explore where your unique skills might take flight. Please submit a cover letter outlining your strengths and your highest accomplishments, in addition to your resume and contact info. As Boom continues to scale toward our next milestones, we’re planning to add key talent across multiple disciplines. Boom is an equal opportunity employer, including for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. We are building a culture of merit and excellence.

southparkcommons-meesho:lever:5afe596f-1.title: Assistant Manager - Ops
southparkcommons-meesho:lever:5afe596f-1.description: About the Team Meesho Mall is Meesho’s branded commerce business, focused on building a trusted destination for branded products across categories for users. We are chasing a goal to acquire wallet share of a user on branded items. It is a rocket-ship within Meesho that has been growing super fast YoY About the Role Meesho is building one of India's largest distributor networks to enable faster deliveries, lower shipping costs, and deeper brand penetration across the country. As a Distributor Onboarding Lead (AM – Operations), you will own the complete journey of expanding Meesho's distributor network—from identifying potential distributor partners to successfully onboarding and activating them. This is a high-ownership, field-intensive role that requires strong business development, negotiation, and relationship management skills. You will work closely with brands, distributors, and internal cross-functional teams to build long-term supply infrastructure that powers Meesho's next phase of growth. This role is field-first. Candidates should expect to travel extensively, spending approximately 3 out of every 4 weeks on the ground across different cities and states.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:c43ab912-0d5.title: Ads Quality Rater - Mandarin (Taiwan)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:c43ab912-0d5.description: Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world’s largest Ads Rating Programs and we want you to join! As an Ads Quality Rater, you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users. In other words, you’ll tell the AI program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user’s keywords. You will review ads in both English and Mandarin This role is great for people who: - Surf the internet daily - Use major search engines frequently - Know what people want based on a few keywords - Enjoy researching topics online - Want a flexible and fun side job Project Details Job Title: Ads Quality Rater Pay Rate: Based on tasks (approximately $9 per hour) Location: Remote/work from home - must be based in Taiwan Hours: Set your schedule based on the following – Minimum commitment is 5 hours per week. You can choose to work up to 20 hours per week. Start Date: ASAP Employment Type: Independent Contractor/Freelance/Self-Employed Project Duration: Long-term Note: - Even though the position is WFH, you must reside in the country that is noted in this description. This will be automatically checked during the hiring process. Recruitment Process - There is no formal interview for this job! No phone calls, no waiting, and no wasting time wondering whether you got the job or not. - Instead, you will be guided through a self-paced and automated recruitment process. IMPORTANT NOTE: Welo Data uses numerous identity checks to ensure that everyone who makes the team is real, qualified, and ready to work. To avoid any misunderstandings, do not use IP masking programs (such as VPNs).
